title: WorkerEvidenceFoundPayload
description: Emitted when a worker finds evidence supporting a claim in an active investigation. Every AI conclusion must trace back to evidence.

claim_statement.description: The specific claim this evidence supports

source_timestamp.description: When the source content was originally published

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt that constitutes the evidence

is_independent.description: Is this source independent of other evidence already found?

lineage_parent_url.description: If derived, the original source URL

evidence_id.description: ID of the Evidence row created
